name: Get export preferences
description: Call this when you need to know which subscription fields, system fields, and saved column preferences are available for a contact export, before building an export request. Use it to discover the valid field names to include, then call contacts.export to actually start the export job; if you only need the stored attribute definitions rather than export-specific field groups, use contacts.create_attribute's listing counterpart instead.
preconditions: An authenticated Brevo web app session for the account whose export preferences are read.

objectType.description: The kind of record the export preferences apply to. Observed value: "contact".

subscriptions.description: Subscription field names that can be included in an export, e.g. "email_marketing", "sms_marketing".

systemData.description: System field names that can be included in an export, e.g. "listId".

exportPreferences.description: Previously saved export preferences for this object type; empty when the user has never saved any.
